verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts: a folder holding a SKILL.md of YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, with optional scripts, references and assets. They follow the published Agent Skills open standard, which is built for cross-platform portability across multiple AI tools. A hands-on probe confirmed third-party tooling installs the official skills with no Anthropic account, and a community developer ported them to a Gemini-based model-agnostic setup, so local skill data is inherently in open, portable formats. Missing for 10: any documented export or download path for skills uploaded through the Skills API or Claude.ai workspaces, and any account-level data export.
